c5 1/1
:= percent (s : string) : string = sm'::percent_encode s

c6 1/1
:= clock_seed () : string =
    := micros = unix_clock::nanos_count (unix_clock::unix_now_nanos ()) / 1000u64
    sm'::obj_to_string micros ++# "-" ++# sm'::obj_to_string (env::process_id ())

c7 1/1
:= unix_seconds () : string = unix_clock::unix_now_seconds () |> unix_clock::seconds_count |> sm'::obj_to_string
